body.statement: In the one-donor equal-Bernoulli post subexperiment with donor knot displacement \(h_B/\sqrt{m_\ell}\), the simplex is the singleton \(\Delta_1=\{1\}\), so \(\widehat w_\ell=w_\ell=1\), \(v_\ell=0\), and the weight quadratic, \(B_{t,\ell}\) cross contribution, and all \(\epsilon_{t,\ell}\) remainder terms are identically zero. The anchored limit is \(\Psi^B_{h_B}=|Z_0-h_B-Z_1|+|Z_0|+|Z_1|-|Z_0-h_B|-|h_B+Z_1|+h_B\), where \(Z_0,Z_1\) are independent \(N(0,1/4)\). Its exact distribution function reduces to a one-dimensional Gaussian integral, and the least common 95 percent squared-radius cutoff \(c_B^*\) satisfies \(1.913<c_B^*\leq1.914\), while the collision-oracle cutoff is \(1.38590382435\). Any uniformly honest plug-in-centered radius with a deterministic collision limit has that limit at least \(c_B^*\).
body.justification: The explicit frontier proves that uniform local honesty costs strictly more than collision-oracle calibration.
body.gap: Robins--van der Vaart and Hoffmann--Nickl give general adaptation obstructions, but neither computes the least-favorable intermediate knot offset for this discrete DSC QTE loss.
body.consumer: It prevents collision-only or separated-only critical values from undercovering the post-treatment intervention-versus-no-intervention QTE at nearly colliding mosquito-abundance masses.
